rule: After production, lead-loss, incorrect-data and broken-user-journey emergencies, prioritize the tour-search UX and user-facing visual layer using ANYTOUR DESIGN SYSTEM 2.0 as the only canonical design system. Improve search form, full-search filters, results, hotel/tour cards, selected-tour UX and desktop/mobile visual consistency; converge shared header/navigation/footer and broader site visuals on DS2 where required by user-facing work. Keep technical_refactor deferred until a new explicit owner direction. Do not introduce or restore Design System 1.0. Preserve Yandex Metrika/goals, external lead contract, Tourvisor contract and neighboring project boundaries.
